description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractModuleController which extends another class AbstractController and provides a mechanism to initialize and access a HomePageService instance. It serves as a base controller class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for modules, and manages service dependency injection.

classes.name: AbstractModuleController
classes.description: An abstract controller class that manages an instance of HomePageService, providing a lazy-initialization getter method.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Provides access to the HomePageService instance, creating it if it hasn't been instantiated yet.
